feeding_claim.verbatim: To enhance their marbling and flavor, we feed them the corn we plant, grow, and grind on our farm.

notes: Checked 2026-11-15: our story, whole and quarter deposit product pages, purchasing terms and side of beef guide (hagemannbeef.com and the shop and FAQ index pages could not be fetched). Hereford cattle are born and raised on the farm, pasture-raised with hay in winter, and fed corn the farm grows, so the category is grain-finished. Whole ($1,200 deposit), half and quarter beef only; the quarter deposit shows sold out while the whole deposit could be added to cart. Pickup is at Johnson's Processing in Chadwick, IL; no farm pickup, delivery or shipping.
